recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century music album cover featuring a centered portrait of a male performer in a brown cardigan against a vibrant cyan background, flanked by a large, jagged, two-tone diamond graphic containing expressive, custom-lettered text.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject portrait anchored to the bottom right, overlapping the background elements.
Geometric diamond graphic acting as a high-contrast pedestal for the primary title.
Horizontal rule lines at the top creating a structured header for metadata.
Vibrant primary color palette (cyan, red, yellow) contrasting with the earthy tones of the subject.
coreInvariants: Split-color diamond (red top, yellow bottom) with jagged edges.
Subject wearing a textured olive-brown knit cardigan over a white collared shirt.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the lower right quadrant, scaled to approximately 60% of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red and yellow diamond graphic in the upper left serves as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold title in the diamond, move right to the subject's face, then up to the header text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open cyan space in the upper right and center to balance the heavy graphic on the left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan blue background providing a cool, high-energy base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright red and yellow in the geometric graphic for maximum visibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Olive brown and white in the subject's clothing to ground the composition.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in graphic elements versus naturalistic, muted tones in the photographic portrait.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab-serif and jagged display styles.
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses sharp, lightning-bolt-like terminals and extreme weight variations.
Secondary text uses a heavy, extended slab-serif with thick horizontal strokes.
Header text is a clean, bold sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title are staggered and tilted to follow the jagged edges of the diamond background.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive decorative display lettering paired with stable, heavy slab-serifs for a 'loud' retro feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the jagged, mid-century comic/music energy.
Matches the heavy slab-serif secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a 1950s man in an olive-brown cardigan and white shirt, holding an acoustic guitar, set against a solid cyan blue background. In the upper left, place a large jagged diamond shape, red on top and yellow on the bottom, with a thick black outline.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, jagged custom lettering in yellow and red with thick black outlines over the diamond. Add heavy black slab-serif text in the upper right over three thin horizontal black lines.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, vibrant cyan?
Does the diamond graphic have sharp, irregular 'lightning' edges?
Is the main title text heavily outlined in black?
Is the subject wearing a textured brown knit cardigan?

adjustableVariables: Density of the horizontal rule lines
Degree of tilt in the display lettering
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Unique brand logos in the corners

mustAchieve: Hand-drawn feel to the primary typography
avoid: Clean vector edges on the jagged diamond

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not look like a standard modern font.
Ensure the cyan background is flat and untextured.
Verify the subject's pose is relaxed and centered-right.
Confirm the red/yellow split in the diamond is horizontal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a naturalistic mid-century portrait with aggressive, jagged geometric shapes and high-contrast primary colors to evoke early rock-and-roll energy.
